description: Queues a rebuild of the cookie banner script for one of your CookiePal domains, so it picks up the settings saved for it. It changes no setting and works on one domain only. If the domain has reached its page-view limit nothing is rebuilt, and the result says so.

domainId.description: Which domain to rebuild. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

name: regenerate_banner
title: Rebuild the banner
